== 🗂️ Backlog (not scheduled) ==
Tasks that are worth doing next, but that are not part of the current time period. Tick a task as soon as you move it into the to-do list above.

*<bs:checkbox checked="false" /> '''Task name:''' short description

=== Notes ===

== 🚫 Out of scope ==
Tasks that will deliberately '''not''' be done in this project or time period. Naming them prevents repeated discussions.

*'''Task name:''' short description
